shots.text: If anyone learns how they did it,
The army needs a way to fool the Germans.
each one light enough for four men to carry.
At night, they pump up a whole division in an empty field.
By morning, German planes count hundreds of tanks.
You can hear them fifteen miles away.
Fake operators send fake orders to fake units.
Men sew on other units' badges,
sit in cafés, and loudly spill the wrong secrets.
One small army pretending to be big ones.
The real army is about to cross.
The ghosts set up miles away.
Their guns point at the wrong river bank.
The army keeps it secret for fifty years.
The strongest Americans in France are holding balloons.
And they save thousands of lives.
